verdict.rationale: Sketch offers a documented JavaScript plugin API, sketchtool CLI for 'creating assets with a single command,' a sketch:// URL scheme, and an MCP server enabling AI clients to interact with Sketch — collectively a programmatic surface an agent could use. However, there is no dedicated documentation of a rendering/export API for screenshots or production formats (e.g., PNG/SVG/PDF export commands) beyond the vague 'create assets' claim, and no OpenAPI/REST surface (probes return 404s). missing for 10: explicit export/render API docs with format options, confirmed asset-export examples via CLI/MCP, independent verification of export fidelity, and a REST/OpenAPI surface.
